items.title: FarEye helps reduce e-commerce major Flipkart logistics expenses by 6%
items.rss_summary: AI-powered enterprise SaaS Far Eye on Sunday said it has helped e-commerce major Flipkart's B2B cash-and-carry market place, Flipkart Wholesale, slash its logistics spend by 6 per cent besides an 8 per cent reduction in vehicle deployment pan-India. This has enabled Flipkart Wholesale to improve fleet productivity without compromising delivery efficiency, reducing vehicle idle time by 10 per cent, Far Eye said in a statement. The improvements come from digitising and connecting dispatch, routing, compliance and payment collection processes across a network comprising 26 stores and one cross-dock, it said. Flipkart Wholesale's network processes more than 200,000 orders and about 195,000 vehicle assignments a month. The platform said it now supports the movement of goods across this network through a unified digital workflow, replacing largely manual and fragmented dispatch processes. items.title: MPCB asks Adani firm to stop work on temporary labour camp in Satara
items.rss_summary: The Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) has directed Adani Renewable Energy One Ltd to stop excavation and construction work for its temporary camp in Satara district for allegedly beginning these without obtaining the necessary environmental clearance and permissions. The labour camp in Satara's Patan taluka, some 300 kilometres from here, is part of the firm's 1500 MW Tarali Pumped Storage Project. In a stop-work notice dated November 20, the MPCB said the company had started excavation and development work at Gat Nos. 33 and 34 in Sawargahar village for a temporary labour camp and other storage activities without informing the board or obtaining the required permissions. The company had not secured environmental clearance for the excavation and development work from the competent authority, the MPCB added. The notice, issued under Section 33A of the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1974, and Section 31A of the Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act .

items.title: ITC extends Braille-enabled packaging to Fiama, takes total to 16 SKUs
items.rss_summary: Alongside an industry-wide shift toward AI-enabled personalisation and algorithmic optimisation, diversified conglomerate ITC Ltd is pursuing an analogue, inclusive approach to product innovation by incorporating raised Braille text on select personal care items from its Savlon and Fiama portfolios. The initiative makes everyday consumer products more accessible to millions of visually impaired people in India, for whom routine activities such as identifying a handwash bottle or choosing the right personal care product can pose challenges. Building on Savlon's introduction of India's first Braille-enabled FMCG packaging in 2018, ITC's Personal Care Products Business has now extended the initiative to Fiama. It now has 16 SKUs from the personal care segment under accessible packaging. Braille identifiers are currently featured on technically feasible product packs, such as Savlon Antiseptic Disinfectant Liquid, Savlon Wet Wipes and Handwash Pumps, as well as Fiama Shower Gels. items.title: Shree Cement to cross 100 MT capacity in 3-4 yrs, targets 9-10% growth
items.rss_summary: Shree Cement, the country's third-largest cement maker by installed capacity, is expecting to cross the 100 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) production capacity over the next three to four years, driven by an aggressive expansion push and steady demand from the country's infrastructure and housing sectors, said its Chairman Hari Mohan Bangur. In an interaction with PTI, Bangur said the company is targeting a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 9-10 per cent over the next six to seven years, higher than the expected 7-8 per cent growth in the overall Indian cement industry. Shree Cement Ltd (SCL), which earlier this month announced a Rs 7,000 crore investment to set up cement plants in Andhra Pradesh as part of its expansion, expects to reach 80 MTPA capacity in the next two years, he said. In response to a question on whether Shree Cement would cross 100 MTPA, Bangur told PTI: "Yes, in the next 3-4 years." SCL is having a combined investment of nearly Rs 3,500 crore to Rs 4,000 cr

In an interview with PTI, ORN Ventures Founder & CEO Vinay Gupta shared that the company is looking to deepen its presence in international markets as it scales its direct operator-to-consumer travel platform. "We will be investing north of 10,000 crore globally," he said, confirming that the investment plan was over the next five years," he said and indicated that the deployment could be completed much earlier, "I think we if you ask me it'll be in less than 24 months," he noted. Gupta said the investment would be funded through a combination of the company's cash flows and fundraising. items.title: InvIT IPO rush gathers pace, 4-5 trusts likely to go public by Mar 2027
items.rss_summary: Four to five privately placed Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) are expected to tap the public markets by March 2027 to raise a combined Rs 17,000 crore, as infrastructure developers increasingly turn to this route to mobilise long-term capital and monetise operational assets, investment bankers said. InvITs have already mobilised around Rs 88,000 crore through equity issuances during FY23-FY25, indicating growing investor appetite for infrastructure-backed investment opportunities, according to the Bharat InvITs Association. items.title: Chalet Hotels plans ₹3,500 crore capex over three years: CEO Shwetank Singh
items.rss_summary: Chalet Hotels plans to invest around Rs 3,500 crore over the next three years as it expands its hospitality portfolio, with its upcoming Taj-branded property at Delhi airport now expected to open nearly 200 rooms in the April-June quarter of the next financial year, against an earlier plan of 70 rooms, Managing Director and CEO Shwetank Singh said. The company's upcoming portfolio includes a 380-room Taj hotel at Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL). In an interview to PTI, Singh shared that while the DIAL airport Taj is nearing its completion, pollution-linked GRAP restrictions caused some delay. "Otherwise, our plan was to push in about 70 rooms in the fourth quarter of this financial year. It looks like we'll go into first quarter of next year, but because we have more time on our hands, we will probably bring more number of rooms into play. So instead of 70, we'll probably end up with nearly 200 rooms in that," Singh said. He said the company expected the airport property

items.title: Airbnb looks beyond traditional holiday hubs to deepen presence in India
items.rss_summary: Global hospitality platform Airbnb is looking to deepen its presence in India by expanding beyond traditional holiday destinations, strengthening the homestay ecosystem and bringing more local entrepreneurs onto its platform to tap the country's growing domestic travel market. In an interview with PTI, Airbnb India Country Manager Amanpreet Bajaj said the company's India growth strategy will focus on expanding quality accommodation supply, enabling more communities to participate in tourism and diversifying its offerings beyond stays through experiences and services. "We will also continue expanding quality supply, both in traditional leisure markets and metros and in emerging destinations such as spiritual corridors and nature-led locations. We want travellers to have more choices and local communities to benefit from tourism," Bajaj shared. He highlighted that India is one of Airbnb's fastest-growing origin markets globally, with domestic travel emerging as a major growth driver.

items.title: EV brand E-Went eyes mass market, to test sodium-ion batteries from Dec
items.rss_summary: Kolkata-based Saraogi E-Ventures, which markets electric two-wheelers under the E-Went brand, sees significant growth opportunities in India's price-sensitive markets, particularly in the sub-Rs 1 lakh segment, while exploring sodium-ion battery technology as an alternative to conventional lithium-ion batteries, its founder and CEO Umang Kumar Saraogi said. The company plans to begin trials of sodium-ion battery-powered scooters around December, deploying some vehicles for testing. The technology is being explored for its potential safety advantages over conventional lithium-ion batteries, although its relatively lower energy density makes the battery packs bulkier, Saraogi said. "It is supposed to be safer. We expect to conduct trials here starting in December and deploy some vehicles with these batteries. The economics and convenience have to be evaluated before we can deploy them in our new product launches. Currently, most of the models use lithium-ion technology," he told PTI.

He, however, clarified that the 18-month timeline is broad and the company has not finalised a listing date, as it does not want the management to get distracted by the process and effort involved in an initial public offering (IPO). items.title: Gokul hikes buffalo milk price by ₹6, cow milk by ₹4; farmers unhappy
items.rss_summary: The Kolhapur District Cooperative Milk Producers' Union, popularly known as Gokul Milk Union, has decided to increase the selling price of buffalo milk by Rs 6 per litre and cow milk by Rs 4 per litre with immediate effect, its chairman Rajesh Patil said on Saturday. The decision was taken unanimously by all 25 directors due to the drought situation and the difficulties faced by farmers, Patil, a former MLA, said. The union has also decided to raise the procurement rates paid to milk producers by Rs 3 per litre for buffalo milk and Rs 2 per litre for cow milk, he said, adding that this hike was "historic". "The revised rates will come into effect from November 21 and remain applicable for around 131 days, till March. The situation will be reviewed every month, and the board will take further decisions depending on the circumstances," Patil said. items.hinglish_title: Gokul Ne Badhaye Doodh Ke Daam, Bhains Ka Doodh ₹6 Aur Gaye Ka ₹4 Hua Mehenga
items.explanation: Gokul Milk Union ne bhains ke doodh ki selling price mein ₹6 prati litre aur gaye ke doodh mein ₹4 prati litre ki badtari ki hai. Chairman Rajesh Patil ke mutabik, sookhe ki sthiti aur kisano ki mushkilon ko dekhte hue sabhi 25 directors ne milkar ye faisla liya hai. Naye daam 21 November se lagoo hokar March tak lagbhag 131 dino tak laagu rahenge.

items.title: Hero FinCorp aims to double loan disbursements over next two quarters
items.rss_summary: Hero FinCorp aims to double its loan disbursement volumes over the next two quarters, after disbursing over 4.80 lakh loans across northern India between January and September this year. Financial services company Hero FinCorp Ltd is a division of two-wheeler manufacturer Hero MotoCorp. The company's growth plans will be supported by its diversified lending portfolio, distribution network and artificial intelligence-led underwriting capabilities, according to a statement. The non-banking financial company caters to diverse financing needs through a comprehensive portfolio of retail, MSME and corporate lending solutions. "Over 4.8 lakh households and businesses across seven states have chosen us this year for a two-wheeler, a car, a personal loan, working capital or a loan against property. "We aim to double our growth in the region over the next two quarters while keeping the customer's trust at the centre of every decision we make," Hero FinCorp's spokesperson said.
items.hinglish_title: Hero FinCorp Agle Do Quarters Mein Loan Disbursement Double Karne Ki Taiyari Mein

Is plan ko unke diversified portfolio, distribution network aur AI-led underwriting system se support milega. Company retail, MSME aur corporate sectors ki financing zaroorato ko poora karti hai.

items.title: Ashok Leyland to set up truck plant in Singur, work to begin soon: Minister
items.rss_summary: Union Minister Sukanta Majumdar on Saturday said commercial vehicle manufacturer Ashok Leyland would set up a truck manufacturing plant in Singur, with work on the project expected to begin soon, reviving hopes of industrialisation at the site where the Tata Nano project was abandoned nearly two decades ago. Speaking to reporters after Prime Minister Narendra Modi's programme at IIT Kharagpur, Majumdar said the BJP government was committed to bringing industry to Singur and that the proposed facility would manufacture heavy vehicles. "We want to bring industry back to Singur. Our chief minister has also said so. I am reiterating today that Ashok Leyland is coming to Singur. It will set up a truck manufacturing plant, and work will begin soon," the Union minister of state for education said. items.title: GST Network adds metro rail as fifth mode of transport in e-way bill system
items.rss_summary: The GST Network (GSTN) has added metro rail as a new mode of transport in the e-way bill system. Currently, the facility has also been released in the "Sandbox environment" for API users to test and make necessary changes to their systems. Its roll-out in the live API environment will be announced separately, GSTN, which manages the IT backbone of Goods and Services Tax, said. The facility follows a government notification dated October 26. With this addition, the e-way bill system now has five modes of transport: Road, Rail, Air, Ship and Metro Rail. Under the Goods and Services Tax (GST), the e-way bill is mandatory for transiting goods valued at Rs 50,000 and above, both inter- and intra-state. GSTN, in an advisory issued on November 20, said the new option is available to web users for generating e-way bills and updating transport details. Users transporting goods through metro rail must select it as the mode of transport and enter the mandatory transport document number. Th
items.hinglish_title: E-Way Bill System Mein Metro Rail Bana Transport Ka 5th Mode
items.explanation: GST Network (GSTN) ne e-way bill system mein ab Metro Rail ko naye transport mode ke roop mein shamil kiya hai. Is naye jod ke baad system mein Road, Rail, Air, Ship aur Metro Rail samet kul paanch modes ho gaye hain. Ye facility abhi API users ke liye sandbox environment mein testing ke liye available hai, jabki web users isse transport details update kar sakte hain. GST ke tehat ₹50,000 ya usse zyada ke saaman ke transit par e-way bill mandatory hota hai.

items.title: Adani Energy to supply 2,500 MW renewable energy to West Bengal discom
items.rss_summary: Adani Energy Solutions Ltd (AESL) on Saturday said its wholly-owned subsidiary Powerpulse Trading Solutions Ltd (PTSL) has bagged a project to supply up to 2,500 MW of renewable energy to West Bengal discom WBSEDCL for 25 years. The Letter of Award (LoA) from West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Co Ltd (WBSEDCL) is for the supply of 1,750 MW of renewable energy round-the-clock for a period of 25 years. The LoA provides a 750 MW green shoe option, which, upon exercise, would take the aggregate contracted capacity to 2,500 MW, AESL said in a statement. The award follows a competitive bidding process. Power supply is scheduled to begin from July 1, 2028, for 1,750 MW capacity and from April 1, 2029, for 750 MW, once the green shoe option is exercised, it said "Round-the-clock renewable power will be critical to India's energy transition, combining the sustainability of renewables and optimising transmission systems usage. items.title: Bank of Maharashtra explores AMC business, overseas bond issue: MD & CEO
items.rss_summary: The state-owned lender is evaluating an entry into asset management and a potential $175 million overseas bond issue before the RBI's concessional swap window closes in December
items.hinglish_title: Bank of Maharashtra Karega AMC Business Aur Overseas Bond Issue Par Kaam
items.explanation: Bank of Maharashtra asset management business me enter karne ke vikalp par vichar kar raha hai. Bank lagbhag $175 million ka overseas bond issue lane ki bhi tayyari me hai. Ye kadam RBI ki concessional swap window December me band hone se pehle uthaye jane ki ummeed hai.

items.title: Markets gain 2.6% on FPI inflows, rupee rally and cooling crude oil prices
items.rss_summary: The NSE Nifty 50 ended at 25,800.60, up 1.12 per cent on Friday and 2.61 per cent for the week. The Sensex gained 2.85 per cent over the week, and 1.08 per cent on Friday, closing at 83,919.71
items.hinglish_title: Weekly Basis Par Sensex Aur Nifty Me Zabardast Tezi
items.explanation: NSE Nifty 50 Friday ko 1.12% chadhkar 25,800.60 par band hua aur poore hafte me 2.61% badha. Sensex Friday ko 1.08% tezi ke sath 83,919.71 par close hua. Poore hafte ke dauran Sensex me kul 2.85% ka munafa darj kiya gaya.
